sloka: प्राप्तम् आवेदयामासुः नृपायैः इक्ष्वाकवे तदा ।तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सपुरोधाः समाहितः ॥१-१८-४२॥
transliteration: prāptam āvedayāmāsuḥ nṛpāyaiḥ ikṣvākave tadā ।teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā sapurodhāḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1-18-42॥

translations.english: Seeing Viswamitra, shining with the power of his penance fulfilled the king with a cheerful countenance made offerings with due respect.
